name: Covariance Matrix (CM) Splatting
definition: A surface aligned splatting technique where splat orientation and size are estimated by solving the eigenvalue and eigenvector problems associated with a covariance matrix. It aligns splats with the direction of minimal curvature.
summary: Covariance Matrix Splatting is a surface-aligned technique that orients elliptical patches using local geometric statistics, providing shape-aware, rotationally invariant orientations unlike the globally coherent Householder method.
